lines: What is the Unsurpassable, Kaula-fruiting at once,
that by mere knowing brings Khecarī-evenness?
sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet

lines: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the heart-dwelling Power,
sanskrit_cite: etadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā

lines: Tell me of her, god of gods, by whom to fullness I attain —
Hear, blessed Goddess: beyond all answering, the Unsurpassed.
sanskrit_cite: tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ labhāmyaham | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram

lines: Kaula this rite, O Goddess, in my heart-sky set:
I tell, O lady of gods: swift is its fruit.
sanskrit_cite: kauliko'yaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomnyavasthitaḥ | kathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam

lines: First now: all lunar days, vowels drop-ending all;
within, time-yoked, moon and sun are named.
sanskrit_cite: athādyāstithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānagāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau

lines: From earth to person, principles five by five in train —
in ka-sets, in sounds, in ma-endings they remain.
sanskrit_cite: pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate

lines: Fourfold the holds of wind-fire-water lords on high;
above, the famed śa-row; first, brahmas five.
sanskrit_cite: vāyvāgnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakam

lines: Rootless, rightly ranged, to be known, in kṣa it ends —
this forthgoing told, of every mantra and wisdom-kind.
sanskrit_cite: amūlā tatkramājjñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā | sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini

lines: This is the womb, told in all Tantras evermore —
with fourteen joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma,
O fair of hip, the heart of Bhairava's own form.
sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ yoni samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvathā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ |
